title: work-source input
description: Input of the extension point orch:work-source: claim a piece of work, brief it, or register its outcome.

runId.description: Id of the orchestration run; it is also the owner session of the claimed work and part of the attempt id, so it uses the attempt-id characters and leaves room for the reference.

attemptId.description: Key of one attempt at the work.

actor.description: Provider, model and optional reasoning effort of an actor.

provider.description: Provider identifier, such as claude-code or codex.

claim.description: Claim one piece of work for a run: the first of items, or the next ready one of the source.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

items.description: Candidate references in order; without it the source picks the next ready piece.
Reference of a piece of work.

orch_config.description: Invocation configuration file of the orch command that claims; the source passes it back to orch when it asks orch.

brief.description: Build the content-addressed brief of a claimed piece of work.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work.

unit.description: Part of the piece of work to brief, when only one part is run.

register.description: Register the outcome of a piece of work: owner fencing and the evidence gate first, then the record.

plan.description: Work source collection, such as a plan id or path.

plans_root.description: Folder that holds the collection, when not the default.

ref.description: Reference of the piece of work.

run_id.description: Run that claimed the work; it must still own it.

attempt_id.description: Attempt being registered; a repeat is a no-op.

evidence.description: Check-evidence file of each acceptance check, by check id.
